## Outcome

What independently useful outcome should become possible?

## Current limitation

What concrete workflow or evidence gap exists today?

## Boundaries

What should be explicitly in scope and out of scope?

## Acceptance evidence

How could a reviewer independently verify that the outcome works?

## Alternatives and reuse

Which existing SpecGrain capability, standard library feature, or external interface could be reused before adding new surface area?
